en: A vintage monochrome postcard view over a small town set in a valley with surrounding hills and forests. In the foreground is an open grassy field with rows of young trees or shrubs. Behind it are several houses and villas, some with steep roofs and decorative façades, and further back a wooded hillside and distant ridges. A river or pond is visible to the left. The title "Bad Sachsa a. Harz." is printed in red at the top left, and small red vertical print with a number and publisher appears along the right edge.
